body_markdown:
*New campaign connects AI-powered performance insights linking advanced molecular intelligence to help detect cancer in earlier stages*


**IRVING, Texas – October 19, 2026** –[Caris Life Sciences](https://www.carislifesciences.com/) ®, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAI), a leading TechBio company, today announced the launch of the second commercial in a series promoting Caris Detect™, Caris’ multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test, featuring three-time major champion professional golfer, Jordan Spieth.


The campaign emphasizes that while modern technology can measure nearly every aspect of athletic performance, the same level of intelligence can be applied to helping people find early stage cancer – when treatment is most effective. The new commercial explores how artificial intelligence has transformed golf, analyzing millions of swings and countless data points to help players improve performance. The commercial highlights how Caris is applying decades of expertise in molecular science and artificial intelligence to help identify cancer-associated molecular signals through a simple blood draw.


“Artificial intelligence is transforming nearly every aspect of our lives, from how we work and communicate to how athletes refine their performance,” said[David Dean Halbert](https://www.carislifesciences.com/bio/david-dean-halbert-dsc-hc/) , Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Caris Life Sciences. “At Caris, we believe one of the most important applications of AI is helping advance early stage cancer detection. Caris Detect combines comprehensive molecular analysis with advanced artificial intelligence to help create a future where cancer may be detected in early stage, when there is the best chance for cure.”


“Every golfer is looking for an edge. We use technology to measure everything from ball speed to spin rate because better information leads to better decisions. That’s what resonated with me about Caris Detect. If advanced artificial intelligence can help us understand our golf game, it should also help us better understand our health. Raising awareness about the importance of early detection is something I’m proud to support,” said Jordan Spieth, three-time major champion professional golfer.


Unlike approaches that evaluate only a limited subset of biomarkers, Caris Detect™ leverages ultra-deep leverages Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) for all 23,000 genes, Whole Transcriptome Sequencing (WTS) and advanced artificial intelligence to analyze the full breadth of cancer-associated molecular signals in both DNA and RNA. This comprehensive approach is designed to provide a more complete picture of early stage cancer biology, enabling the identification of molecular patterns associated with cancer through a single blood draw and helping support earlier stage detection when cancers are most treatable.


To view the[commercial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdPoTMY69P8) ,[interview with Jordan Spieth and David Halbert](https://youtu.be/1xrlqlQi164?si=X8Oza4QKjZIcZaJw) and learn more about Caris Detect visit[CarisDetect.com](https://www.carislifesciences.com/carisdetect/) .


**About Caris Detect**


Caris Detect™ is a multi-cancer early detection blood test designed to identify cancer-associated molecular signals using ultra-deep Whole Genome Sequencing, Whole Transcriptome Sequencing and advanced artificial intelligence. The test analyzes a broad range of molecular information to help detect cancer-associated signals at the earliest stage of disease, when it is most curable.


**About Caris Life Sciences**


Caris Life Sciences® (Caris) is a leading TechBio company actively developing and commercializing innovative solutions to transform healthcare. Through comprehensive molecular profiling (Whole Genome, Whole Exome and Whole Transcriptome Sequencing), advanced AI and machine learning, Caris has created the large-scale, multimodal clinico-genomic database and computing capability needed to analyze and further unravel the molecular complexity of disease. This convergence of next-generation sequencing, AI and machine learning technologies and high-performance computing provides a differentiated platform for developing the latest generation of advanced precision medicine diagnostic solutions for early detection, diagnosis, monitoring, therapy selection and drug development.


Caris was founded with a vision to realize the potential of precision medicine to improve the human condition. Headquartered in Irving, Texas, Caris has offices in Phoenix, New York, Cambridge (MA), Tokyo, Japan and Basel, Switzerland. Caris or its distributor partners provide services in the U.S. and other international markets.
